lines.t: **Verse 1**
I'm surrounded by darkness
Everywhere I turn
So many voices calling
Telling me what I should learn
They say, “Come follow us, it's easier here”
And for a moment, the way seems clear
But in my heart I know
Yours is the better road
**Pre-Chorus**
I won't trade His peace for what only brings sorrow
I won't trade His love for what will be gone tomorrow
**Chorus**
Look at the world around me
What has it become?
So much hurt, so much hatred
So much running from the truth
But I know what I believe
And I know where I belong
And I know where I belong
The world may make an empty promise,
They might say "This is what You need"
But I don't need all this darkness
All I need is You
**Verse 2**
The world may look like it's great,
When everything shines bright
Really it's just darkness,
Always night.
But I would rather walk Your way
Than leave You for an easier day
**Pre-Chorus**
I won't exchange forever
For something passing by
I won't let the darkness
Tell me where to set my eyes
**Chorus**
Look at the world around me
What has it become?
So much hurt, so much hatred
So much running from the truth
But I know what I believe
And I know where I belong
The world may make an empty promise,
They might say "This is what You need"
But I don't need all this darkness
All I need is You
**Bridge**
When the voices get louder
And the truth gets harder to hear
When the things I once trusted
Disappear
I'll remember Your goodness
I'll remember Your name
Though the whole world may change
You will always stay the same
**Final Chorus**
Look at the world around me
I see what it has become
So much hurt, so much hatred
So much hiding from the truth
But I know what I believe
And I know where I belong
YahuShua, stay beside me
I will follow You
